visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Items Equal to the Pivot Disappear
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Sorting 3, 1, 3, 2, 3 should give [1,2,3,3,3], but the program prints [1,2,3].

solution.explanation: Every item other than the pivot must go to one of the two sides. With > the items equal to the pivot belong to neither list and vanish. One of the two conditions must include equality.
